html.body: Date: 2025-03-11 REMARKSApplicant respectfully requests entry of the above amendments and following remarks in response to the Office Action of January 17, 2025 ("Office Action"). Upon entry of the present amendment, claims 38-40 will be pending in this application. Claims 1-37 and 41 are canceled.Applicant respectfully requests reconsideration and allowance of the pending claims.I. Allowable Subject Matter Applicant notes with appreciation that claims 38-40 are allowed.In view of the cancelation of the remaining claims, Applicant submits that the application is in condition for allowance II. Claim Reiections under 35 U.S.C. § 103 Claims 24 and 29-31 are rejected under 35 U.S.C. § 103 as unpatentable over U.S. Pub.No. 2013/0248655 to Kroll et al. ("Kroll") in view of U.S. Pub. No. 2015/0360783 to Cailleteau et al. ("Cailleteau"). Claims 25-27 are rejected under 35 U.S.C. § 103 as unpatentable over Kroll in view of Cailleteau and U.S. Pub. No. 2018/0281963 to Dowty et al. ("Dowty"). Claims 24-31 and 33-36 are rejected under 35 U.S.C. § 103 as unpatentable over Dowty in view of Kroll and Cailleteau. Claim 37 is rejected under 35 U.S.C. § 103 as unpatentable over Dowty in view of Kroll, Cailleteau, and U.S. Patent No. 5,024,398 A to Riedinger et al. ("Riedinger").Applicant submits that these rejections are moot because the rejected claims have been canceled.CONCLUSIONIn view of the foregoing, Applicant believes all claims now pending in this application are in condition for allowance. The issuance of a formal Notice of Allowance at an early date is respectfully requested.Except for the issue fees payable under 37 C.F.R. § 1.18, the Director is authorized to charge any additional fees during pendency of this application, including any required extension of time fees, or credit any overpayment to Deposit Account Number 20-1430. This paragraph is intended to be a constructive petition for extension of time in accordance with 37 C.F.R. § 1.136(a)(3).If the Examiner believes a telephone conference would expedite prosecution of this application, please contact the undersigned at 404-815-6015 or aguebert@ktslaw.com.Respectfully submitted, /Anthony Guebert/ Anthony Guebert Registration No. 70,195 KILPATRICK TOWNSEND & STOCKTON LLP
